title: Application package dependency descriptor v1 (DRAFT — Phase 5 APP-502 locks it)
description: dependencies.json inside a signed .formlogic-app archive: what the app needs from the other extension planes. The installer resolves these and tells the user what is present, missing, incompatible, or externally installed. Dependencies are DECLARATIONS — importing an app never silently installs native or server code.

connectors.description: Native connectors the app binds to (satisfied by a Desktop plugin installation + AppBinding).

optional.description: true → the app degrades gracefully (presence callout) instead of failing install

productPage.description: https URL for the external plugin download (no in-app binary downloads)

aiCapabilities.description: Logical AI capability aliases the device owner maps to provider profiles (ADR-008). Never a machine provider id, never a secret.

hostedOperations.description: Typed service.invoke capabilities the deployment must provide (ADR-004).
